# GitHub Copilot instructions

Before making changes, read the repository root AGENTS.md and the relevant design documents in docs/.

Project intent: a small, mobile-first, single-page Chinese workplace-survival choice game. Keep the implementation simple. Prefer data-driven scenarios and explicit ending/transition rules. Do not add infrastructure or dependencies without a clear MVP need. Preserve source attribution for real-world research and distinguish documented facts from fictional adaptation. Validate event IDs and all scenario transitions when story data is added.
